key.headline: 11.5 t/h needs high-capacity T-2103 trays
key.request: Feed +21 % (9.5 -> 11.5 t/h). Keep the isomer separation (product purity checks). Do not explain or sweep: propose a design now. If the existing T-2103 internals flood, replace them with replace_unit and a new rating (vendor to confirm). Column flow amounts are written at today's throughput; the solver scales them. Make the design pass every engineering check.
